29000.commentary: (MNa) ṭhapitāni paṭikkhittānī'ti diṭṭhigatāni nāma na byākātabbānī'ti evaṃ ṭhapitāni c'eva paṭikkhittāni ca.

examples.text: saṅghe vinicchayakathā nāma vatthu vā ārocitaṃ hoti avinicchitaṃ, ñatti vā ṭhapitā hoti, kammavācā vā vippakatā hoti.
idha mayhaṃ, bhante, rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi, yān'imāni diṭṭhigatāni bhagavatā abyākatāni ṭhapitāni paṭikkhittāni… tāni me bhagavā na byākaroti.

29001.meaning1: set down; written down; put in place

examples.text: taḷākaṃ vasupūritaṃ ghammapathe, tividh'aggipiḷesita-nibbāpanaṃ, byādhi-panudana-osadhayo, pacchimasuttapavarā ṭhapitā.

29006.grammar: pr, pass of ṭhapeti, caus, intrans
29006.meaning1: is stored; is kept; is set aside
29006.base: √ṭhā + āpe + īya > ṭhāpīya > ṭhapiyya (caus, pass, irreg)

examples.text: yaṃ tasmiṃ kule uppajjati khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā tato āyasmato upanandassa sakyaputtassa paṭiviso ṭhapiyyati.

29007.meaning1: (of a seat) should be set up; should be placed

examples.text: api ca kho āsanaṃ ṭhapetabbaṃ, sace ākaṅkhissati nisīdissatī'ti.

29008.meaning1: should be kept; should be maintained
29008.meaning2: should be kept; should be maintained

29009.meaning1: helps to last; causes to remain

examples.text: bahuñ'ca te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū puññaṃ pasavanti, te c'imaṃ saddhammaṃ ṭhapentī'ti.
sace vo, dhanena attho, khippaṃ maṃ bandhanā mocetvā sīsaṃ nhāpetvā ahatavatthāni acchādetvā gandhehi vilimpāpetvā pupphāni pilandhāpetvā ṭhapethā'ti.

29011.meaning1: appoints; establishes; sets up; places (someone in a position)
29011.meaning2: keeps, sets up, establishes, fixes (a date)

examples.text: bhikkhū pana mayaṃ, bhante, ājānīy'eva samāne ājānīyā'ti jānissāma ājānīy'eva samāne ājānīyabhojanaṃ bhojessāma, ājānīy'eva samāne ājānīyaṭhāne ṭhapessāma.
uppātesu nimittesu, lakkhaṇesu ca kovidaṃ, ajjhāyakaṃ mantadharaṃ, porohicce ṭhapeti so.

29012.meaning1: sets aside; puts to one side

examples.text: sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno ek'aṃsabyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na ek'aṃsena byākaroti, vibhajjabyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na vibhajja byākaroti, paṭipucchābyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na paṭipucchā byākaroti, ṭhapanīyaṃ pañhaṃ na ṭhapeti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.

dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, appattova bodhisatto pathaviṃ hoti, cattāro naṃ devaputtā paṭiggahetvā mātu purato ṭhapenti, attamanā, devi, hohi, mahesakkho te putto uppanno'ti. ayam'ettha dhammatā.
are bāla, brāhmaṇa, kiṃ tava ñātakā antaradvāre kahāpaṇaṃ ṭhapenti, parato maṃ harā'ti

29014.meaning1: to appoint; to place in a position
29014.meaning2: to appoint; to establish; lit. to cause to stand
29014.commentary: (DNa) ṭhapetabbaṃ ṭhapetun'ti tasmiṃ tasmiṃ ṭhān'antare ṭhapetabbaṃ ṭhapetuṃ.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño cakkavattissa pariṇāyakaratanaṃ pātubhavati, paṇḍito byatto medhāvī paṭibalo rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ upayāpetabbaṃ upayāpetuṃ apayāpetabbaṃ apayāpetuṃ ṭhapetabbaṃ ṭhapetuṃ.
atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ udak'āvasesaṃ udak'ādhāne ṭhapetvā āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi, passasi no tvaṃ, rāhula, imaṃ parittaṃ udak'āvasesaṃ udak'ādhāne ṭhapitan'ti? evaṃ, bhante.
so gehā nikkhamitvā… akkhīni me dhūmāyantī'ti vatvā nalāṭe hatthaṃ ṭhapetvā uddhaṃ oloketvā, aho dukkhaṃ, ayyo no mahākassapatthero cirassaṃ me kuṭidvāraṃ āgato, atthi nu kho kiñci gehe'ti āha

29017.meaning1: having placed aside; having put down

examples.text: puṇṇo theraṃ disvā'va kasiṃ ṭhapetvā pañcapatiṭṭhitena theraṃ vanditvā, dantakaṭṭhena attho bhavissatī'ti dantakaṭṭhaṃ kappiyaṃ katvā adāsi
deva, idāni ṭhapetvā saccakiriyaṃ añño mama sakkhi n'atthi, sac'āyaṃ dārako tumhe paṭicca jāto, ākāse tiṭṭhatu, no ce, bhūmiyaṃ patitvā maratū'ti bodhisattassa pāde gahetvā ākāse khipi.
atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ udak'āvasesaṃ udak'ādhāne ṭhapetvā āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi, passasi no tvaṃ, rāhula, imaṃ parittaṃ udak'āvasesaṃ udak'ādhāne ṭhapitan'ti?

29019.meaning1: having set up; having arranged; having strengthened

examples.text: kumbh'ūpamaṃ kāyam'imaṃ viditvā, nagar'ūpamaṃ cittam'idaṃ ṭhapetvā. yodhetha māraṃ paññ'āvudhena, jitañ'ca rakkhe anivesano siyā.

29020.meaning1: apart from; except for; putting aside
29020.commentary: (MNa) tato yāni na addasa, tesaṃ dīpan'atthaṃ vuttaṃ ṭhapetvā dve'ti.

examples.text: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ tiṇ'avatthārakena vūpasameyya, ṭhapetvā thullavajjaṃ, ṭhapetvā gihippaṭisaṃyuttan'ti.
addasā kho brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsa-mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni, yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve.

29021.meaning2: placing, setting up, establishing, setting aside

examples.text: nisīdāpetī'ti saṇikaṃ ācariya, saṇikaṃ ācariyā'ti mahantaṃ telaghaṭaṃ ṭhapento viya nisīdāpeti.

29022.meaning1: appointed; established; set up; placed in a position

examples.text: ehi dāni, āvuso, ubho'va santā imaṃ gaṇaṃ pariharāmā'ti. iti kho, aggivessana, āḷāro kālāmo ācariyo me samāno attano antevāsiṃ maṃ samānaṃ attanā samasamaṃ ṭhapesi, uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesi.
mayañ'hi, bhante, pubbe aññatitthiye paribbājake anājānīy'eva samāne ājānīyā'ti amaññimha, anājānīy'eva samāne ājānīyabhojanaṃ bhojimha, anājānīy'eva samāne ājānīyaṭhāne ṭhapimha.

te taṃ saṅkhaṃ avakujjaṃ nipātesuṃ, passena nipātesuṃ, dutiyena passena nipātesuṃ, uddhaṃ ṭhapesuṃ, omuddhakaṃ ṭhapesuṃ, pāṇinā ākoṭesuṃ, leḍḍunā ākoṭesuṃ, daṇḍena ākoṭesuṃ, satthena ākoṭesuṃ, odhuniṃsu sandhuniṃsu niddhuniṃsu, vadehi, bho saṅkha, vadehi, bho saṅkhā'ti.

29025.meaning1: will stand; will stay; will remain; will last

examples.text: pathavīsamaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. pathavīsamañ'hi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato uppannā manāp'āmanāpā phassā cittaṃ na pariyādāya ṭhassanti.
atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ gomayapiṇḍaṃ pāṇinā gahetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca. ettako'pi kho, bhikkhu, attabhāvapaṭilābho n'atthi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassati.
468, 462. ṭhā tiṭṭho.
502, 493. yamhi dā dhā mā ṭhā hā pā maha math'ādīnam'ī.
dvattikkhattuṃ codayamāno sārayamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya, icc'etaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce abhinipphādeyya, catukkhattuṃ pañcakkhattuṃ chakkhattu'paramaṃ tuṇhībhūtena uddissa ṭhātabbaṃ

so khv'āhaṃ, bhante, evaṃ dīgharattaṃ katānaṃ puññānaṃ evaṃ dīgharattaṃ katānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pariyantaṃ n'ādhigacchāmi, ettakaṃ puññan'ti vā ettako puññavipāko'ti vā ettakaṃ sagge ṭhātabban'ti vā'ti.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, uppalaṃ vā padumaṃ vā puṇḍarīkaṃ vā udake jātaṃ udake saṃvaḍḍhaṃ udakā accuggamma ṭhāti anupalittaṃ udakena, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, tathāgato loke jāto loke saṃvaḍḍho lokaṃ abhibhuyya viharati anupalitto lokenā'ti.

29031.meaning1: to stand; to stay; to remain

examples.text: raññā pana vandite bhagavantaṃ avanditvā ṭhātuṃ samattho nāma ekasākiyo'pi n'āhosi, sabbe vandiṃsu'y'eva.
imesaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, samaṇamalānaṃ samaṇadosānaṃ samaṇakasaṭānaṃ āpāyikānaṃ ṭhānānaṃ duggativedaniyānaṃ appahānā, na samaṇasāmīcippaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno'ti vadāmi.
app'ossukko tvaṃ, mahārāja, vīthiyo sodhāpetvā… saparijano uposathaṃ samādiyitvā… sāyanhasamaye mahānāgavan'uyyān'ābhimukho yāhi addhā tasmiṃ ṭhāne dhātuyo lacchasī'ti

29033.synonym: adhikaraṇa, āyatana, ārammaṇa, kāraṇa, nidāna, nibandhana, nimitta, yoni, vatthu

examples.text: saccaṃ bhaṇe na kujjheyya, dajjā appam'pi yācito, etehi tīhi ṭhānehi, gacche devāna santike.
tatr'āvuso therā bhikkhū tīhi ṭhānehi gārayhā bhavanti
koṭisatānaṃ navutīnaṃ, asītiyā'pi ca koṭinaṃ, ete āsuṃ tayo ṭhānā, vimalānaṃ samāgame.
atha antena jahati, sarīraṃ sapariggahaṃ, etadaññāya medhāvī, bhuñjetha ca dadetha ca, datvā ca bhutvā ca yath'ānubhāvaṃ, anindito saggam'upeti ṭhānan'ti.
yo pubbe karaṇīyāni, pacchā so kātum'icchati, sukhā so dhaṃsate ṭhānā, pacchā ca m'anutappati.
mayañ'hi, bhante, pubbe aññatitthiye paribbājake anājānīy'eva samāne ājānīyā'ti amaññimha, anājānīy'eva samāne ājānīyabhojanaṃ bhojimha, anājānīy'eva samāne ājānīyaṭhāne ṭhapimha
atha seṭṭhi taṃ sīse cumbitvā parivāratthāya tassā pañca itthisatāni datvā taṃ attano jeṭṭhadhītuṭṭhāne ṭhapesi
yo so, bhante, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇ'āsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano samma'd'aññāvimutto, so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti
tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato yo yobbane yobbanamado so sabbaso vā pahīyati tanu vā pana hoti.
kvaci c'ādese, paradvebhāvo ṭhāne'ti
sarato parabyañjanassa ṭhān'āsannavasā dvittaṃ.
tīhi kho ahaṃ, jīvaka, ṭhānehi maṃsaṃ paribhogan'ti vadāmi. adiṭṭhaṃ, asutaṃ, aparisaṅkitaṃ, imehi kho ahaṃ, jīvaka, tīhi ṭhānehi maṃsaṃ paribhogan'ti vadāmi.
madhur'aggassā'ti kuddhassa paṭikujjhitvā, akkuṭṭhassa paccakkositvā, pahaṭassa ca paṭipaharitvā sukhaṃ uppajjati, taṃ sandhāya madhur'aggo'ti vutto. imasmiṃ hi ṭhāne pariyosānaṃ aggan'ti vuttaṃ.

29040.commentary: (ANa) ahaṃ tayā satakkhattuṃ niggayhamāno'pi ucchedavādīyevā'ti vadati. iminā nayena sassata-puggala-suññata-vād'ādīsu'pi nayo netabbo. evaṃ ṭhān'āṭhāne saṇṭhāti nāma.

examples.text: sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno ṭhāna-aṭhāne na saṇṭhāti parikappe na saṇṭhāti aññātavāde na saṇṭhāti paṭipadāya na saṇṭhāti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.

29041.commentary: (ANa) ṭhānakusalo'ti yena ṭhānena ṭhito avirādhetvā vijjhituṃ sakkoti, tasmiṃ ṭhāne kusalo.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, yodh'ājīvo ṭhānakusalo ca hoti, dūrepātī ca, akkhaṇavedhī ca, mahato ca kāyassa padāletā.

29042.commentary: (ANa) ṭhānañ'ca ṭhānato'ti kāraṇañ'ca kāraṇato. kāraṇañ'hi yasmā tattha phalaṃ tiṭṭhati, tadāyattavuttitāya uppajjati c'eva pavattati ca, tasmā ṭhānan'ti vuccati.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, tathāgato ṭhānañ'ca ṭhānato aṭṭhānañ'ca aṭṭhānato yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.

so vata, cunda, attanā palipapalipanno paraṃ palipapalipannaṃ uddharissatī'ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. so vata, cunda, attanā apalipapalipanno paraṃ palipapalipannaṃ uddharissatī'ti ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati.

29043.meaning1: with a good stance; (comm) skilled in position
29043.commentary: (ANa) ṭhānakusalo'ti yena ṭhānena ṭhito avirādhetvā vijjhituṃ sakkoti, tasmiṃ ṭhāne kusalo.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, yodh'ājīvo ṭhānakusalo ca hoti, dūrepātī ca, akkhaṇavedhī ca, mahato ca kāyassa padāletā.

29044.meaning1: fact of understanding what is possible
29044.commentary: (DNa) ṭhānakusalatā'ti ye ye dhammā yesaṃ yesaṃ dhammānaṃ hetupaccayā uppādāya taṃ taṃ ṭhānan'ti yā tattha paññā pajānanā'ti (dha. sa. 1344) evaṃ vuttā cakkhuṃ vatthuṃ katvā rūpaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā uppannassa cakkhuviññāṇassa cakkhurūpaṃ (dha. sa. aṭṭha. 1344) ṭhānañ'c'eva kāraṇañ'cā'ti evaṃ ṭhāna-paricchindana-samatthā paññā.

examples.text: ṭhānakusalatā ca aṭṭhānakusalatā ca.

29045.meaning1: gone to good use; gone to a good cause; not gone to waste
29045.commentary: (ANa) ṭhānagataṃ hotī'ti kāraṇagataṃ hoti. kiṃ pana tanti? catūsu pattakammesu ekaṃ bhogehi kattabbakammaṃ bhogajātam'eva ṭhānagataṃ.

examples.text: mitt'āmacce sukheti pīṇeti sammā sukhaṃ pariharati. idam'assa paṭhamaṃ ṭhānagataṃ hoti pattagataṃ āyatanaso paribhuttaṃ.

yathā, bhante nāgasena, yā kāci saritā nāma, sabbā tā mahāsamuddaṃ osaranti, ṭhānagatā vuḍḍhim'āpajjanti. evam'eva kho, bhante nāgasena, yaṃ kiñci bhuttaṃ pītaṃ khāyitaṃ lehitaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ kalalaṃ osarati, ṭhānagataṃ vuḍḍhim'āpajjati
kaṇṭak'āpassayiko'ti ayakaṇṭake vā pakatikaṇṭake vā bhūmiyaṃ koṭṭetvā tattha cammaṃ attharitvā ṭhānacaṅkam'ādīni karoti.

29047.meaning1: it is certainly possible; it is very likely; it could happen that

examples.text: ṭhānañ'hi so manuj'indo, rajjaṃ laddhāna khattiyo, so kuddho rājadaṇḍena, tasmiṃ pakkamate bhusaṃ, tasmā taṃ parivajjeyya, rakkhaṃ jīvitam'attano.

29048.meaning1: from the place; from its position

examples.text: vissaṭṭhī'ti ṭhānato cāvanā vuccati vissaṭṭhī'ti.
idha, bhikkhave, tathāgato ṭhānañ'ca ṭhānato aṭṭhānañ'ca aṭṭhānato yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.

29051.commentary: (DNt) ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu anvaddhamāsaṃ, anumāsaṃ, anusaṃvaccharaṃ vā manussānaṃ pasādāya iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karohī'ti ekassa bhikkhuno āṇāpanaṃ tasmiṃ ṭhāne tassa ṭhapanaṃ nāma hotī'ti āha ṭhān'antare ṭhapetū'ti.

examples.text: samādisatū'ti āṇāpetu ṭhān'antare ṭhapetu.
ye pana ṭhān'antarappattā amaccā vā rājakumārā vā kat'āparādhā honti, te rañño ārocenti, garukaṃ ṭhānaṃ sayaṃ na vinicchinanti.
evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, goṇo kiṭṭh'ādo gāmagato vā araññagato vā, ṭhānabahulo vā assa nisajjabahulo vā na taṃ kiṭṭhaṃ puna otareyya, tam'eva purimaṃ daṇḍasamphassaṃ samanussaranto.

29054.meaning1: it is possible that; it is plausible that

examples.text: so vata, cunda, attanā palipapalipanno paraṃ palipapalipannaṃ uddharissatīti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. so vata, cunda, attanā apalipapalipanno paraṃ palipapalipannaṃ uddharissatī'ti ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati

sampasāde sati eta'r'ahi vā āneñjaṃ samāpajjati paññāya vā adhimuccati kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā. ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati yaṃ taṃsaṃvattanikaṃ viññāṇaṃ assa āneñj'ūpagaṃ. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamā āneñjasappāyā paṭipadā akkhāyati.

29059.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of ṭhāna
29059.meaning1: on the spot; right there; immediately
29059.commentary: (MNa) udāhu ṭhānaso'v'etan'ti udāhu ṭhān'uppattikañāṇena taṅ'khaṇaṃ'y'eva taṃ tathāgatassa upaṭṭhātī'ti pucchati.

examples.text: ayam'pi kho, bhikkhave, ān'āpānassatisamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato santo c'eva paṇīto ca asecanako ca sukho ca vihāro uppann'uppanne ca pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gimhānaṃ pacchime māse ūhataṃ rajojallaṃ, tam'enaṃ mahā-akālamegho ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.

29060.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of ṭhāna
29060.meaning1: according to possibility; (comm) according to cause

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato atīt'ānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.

29061.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of ṭhāna
29061.meaning1: it is possible; it is likely

examples.text: ṭhānañ'hi so manuj'indo, rajjaṃ laddhāna khattiyo, so kuddho rājadaṇḍena, tasmiṃ pakkamate bhusaṃ, tasmā taṃ parivajjeyya, rakkhaṃ jīvitam'attano.
sace, bhikkhave, suvaṇṇakāro vā suvaṇṇakār'antevāsī vā taṃ jātarūpaṃ ek'antaṃ abhidhameyya, ṭhānaṃ taṃ jātarūpaṃ ḍaheyya.

29062.meaning2: it is possible; it is plausible

examples.text: so vata, cunda, attanā palipa-palipanno paraṃ palipapalipannaṃ uddharissatī'ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ vijjati yaṃ girimānandassa bhikkhuno dasa saññā sutvā so ābādho ṭhānaso paṭippassambheyya.

29063.meaning1: what is possible and not possible; possibility and impossibility

29064.meaning1: understanding of what is possible and not possible

29065.meaning1: state of what is and what is possible and not possible; fact of possibility and impossibility

29066.meaning1: what is possible and what is not possible; (comm) what is and what is not the cause

examples.text: katame cattāro? rāgavepullattaṃ, dosavepullattaṃ, mohavepullattaṃ, gambhīresu kho pan'assa ṭhān'āṭhānesu paññācakkhu na kamati. yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā ime cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati, niṭṭham'ettha gantabbaṃ, parihāyāmi kusalehi dhammehi.

29067.meaning1: (in debate) one's own position and the opposing position; premise and counter-premise
29067.commentary: (ANa) ahaṃ tayā satakkhattuṃ niggayhamāno'pi ucchedavādīyevā'ti vadati. iminā nayena sassata-puggala-suññata-vād'ādīsu'pi nayo netabbo. evaṃ ṭhān'āṭhāne saṇṭhāti nāma.

examples.text: sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno ṭhān'āṭhāne na saṇṭhāti parikappe na saṇṭhāti aññātavāde na saṇṭhāti paṭipadāya na saṇṭhāti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.
ṭhān'āṭhāne na saṇṭhātī'ti kāraṇ'ākāraṇe na saṇṭhāti. tatr'āyaṃ nayo, sassatavādī yuttena kāraṇena pahoti ucchedavādiṃ niggahetuṃ, ucchedavādī tena niggayhamāno, kiṃ pan'āhaṃ ucchedaṃ vadāmī'ti

29068.meaning1: skilled in what is possible and what is not possible

examples.text: yato kho, ānanda, bhikkhu dhātukusalo ca hoti, āyatanakusalo ca hoti, paṭiccasamuppādakusalo ca hoti, ṭhān'āṭhānakusalo ca hoti, ettāvatā kho, ānanda, paṇḍito bhikkhu vīmaṃsako'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti.

29069.meaning1: fit to stand; worthy to remain

examples.text: tatra yv'āyaṃ bhikkhu samaggena saṅghena ñatticatutthena kammena akuppena ṭhān'ārahena upasampanno, ayaṃ imasmiṃ atthe adhippeto bhikkhū'ti.

sare lutte paro saro kvaci ṭhān'āsannaṃ dīghaṃ yāti.

29071.meaning1: founded on; supported by; based on

examples.text: atīte, bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati.
tassa te āyasmanto avivaṭañ'c'eva vivaranti, anuttānīkatañ'ca uttānī karonti, anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhāṭhāniyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ paṭivinodenti.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satthāraṃ upanissāya viharati aññataraṃ vā garuṭṭhāniyaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ, yatth'assa tibbaṃ hir'ottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti pemañ'ca gāravo ca.

29074.meaningLit: discourse on serving as a basis

29075.meaning1: founded on; supported by; based on

examples.text: aṭṭhārasamano'pavicāro ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā somanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati, domanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati, upekkhāṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati.

29076.meaning1: being a cause (for); serving as a basis (for); giving support (to)

examples.text: ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannāya vā vicikicchāya uppādāya, uppannāya vā vicikicchāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? atthi, bhikkhave, vicikicchāṭṭhānīyā dhammā.
ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā satisambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā satisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? atthi, bhikkhave, satisambojjh'aṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā.

kiñ'ca n'eva pajahati na upādiyati pajahitvā ṭhito? rūpaṃ… vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṃkhare… viññāṇaṃ n'eva pajahati na upādiyati pajahitvā ṭhito
te ca kho hatthapāsaṃ avijahitvā ekasīmāyaṃ ṭhitā.
tassa sā vimutti sacce ṭhitā akuppā hoti. tañ'hi, bhikkhu, musā yaṃ mosadhammaṃ, taṃ saccaṃ yaṃ amosadhammaṃ nibbānaṃ.
vācaṃ manañ'ca paṇidhāya sammā, kāyena pāpāni akubbamāno, bavhannapānaṃ gharam'āvasanto, saddho mudū saṃvibhāgī vadaññū, etesu dhammesu ṭhito catūsu, dhamme ṭhito paralokaṃ na bhāye'ti.
addasāma kho mayaṃ, bho, taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ gacchantaṃ, addasāma ṭhitaṃ, addasāma antaragharaṃ pavisantaṃ, addasāma antaraghare nisinnaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ
asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī ahosiṃ.
vaggavādakā'ti tassa vaṇṇāya pakkhāya ṭhitā honti.
na antalikkhe na samuddamajjhe, na pabbatānaṃ vivaraṃ pavissa, na vijjati so jagatippadeso, yatthaṭṭhito mucceyya pāpakammā.
